kids.name: The Design Approach RESEARCH → DEFINE → DESIGN → TEST I started with user research and competitor analysis to understand real user needs and pain points. Through interviews and usability insights, I identified the key goals: simple navigation, clear financial visibility, and trust in every transaction. I then translated these insights into a clean, minimal interface with a clear hierarchy, intuitive flows and consistent visual language. The design focused on reducing friction, ensuring security cues are visible, and making core actions easy to find and complete. Business Impact Increased User Activation The simplified onboarding flow led to higher sign-up completion rates and faster time to first transaction. More Transaction Volume A cleaner, faster experience encouraged more frequent and higher-value transactions across borders. Reduced Support Tickets Clearer guidance and intuitive flows resulted in fewer user errors and less need for customer support. Stronger Brand Trust Visible security measures and transparent fees built confidence and long-term loyalty. Confident and Secure Visible security cues, biometric support and trusted payment methods create peace of mind with every transaction.
kids.text:
The Design Approach
RESEARCH → DEFINE → DESIGN → TEST
I started with user research and competitor analysis to understand real user needs and pain points. Through interviews and usability insights, I identified the key goals: simple navigation, clear financial visibility, and trust in every transaction.
I then translated these insights into a clean, minimal interface with a clear hierarchy, intuitive flows and consistent visual language. The design focused on reducing friction, ensuring security cues are visible, and making core actions easy to find and complete.

Business Impact
Increased User Activation
The simplified onboarding flow led to higher sign-up completion rates and faster time to first transaction.
More Transaction Volume
A cleaner, faster experience encouraged more frequent and higher-value transactions across borders.
Reduced Support Tickets
Clearer guidance and intuitive flows resulted in fewer user errors and less need for customer support.
Stronger Brand Trust
Visible security measures and transparent fees built confidence and long-term loyalty.

User Experience
Simple and Intuitive
A clean interface with clear labels and logical flow makes it easy for anyone to send, receive or manage funds.
Faster Access
Key actions are just a tap away, with quick shortcuts for common tasks like deposits, transfers and balance checks.
Greater Control
Real-time balance updates, transaction history and easy wallet management give users full control of their money.
Confident and Secure
Visible security cues, biometric support and trusted payment methods create peace of mind with every transaction.

kids.name: I designed a clean interface with clear visual hierarchy, intuitive navigation, and consistent components. The Orders screens make transaction status easy to scan, while currency indicators and structured offer cards help users quickly understand each transaction. Key Features P2P NGN ↔ USD exchange flow Clear order status: Pending, Completed, Cancelled, and Expired Auto-trade transaction indicators Structured transaction details and timestamps Bottom navigation for quick access to core sections Consistent UI components and responsive mobile layouts Outcome The resulting experience balances clarity, trust, and efficiency, giving users a straightforward way to monitor offers and manage P2P transactions. The goal was to reduce cognitive load, make verification easy to follow, and build trust while collecting the information required to securely onboard users to Blomgram.

defaults.title: Blomgram
defaults.summary: Blomgram is a global cross-border payment platform offering instant, affordable transfers and multi-currency financial tools for Africans worldwide.

sections.heading: The Problem
sections.body:
Cross-border money transfers can be stressful and difficult to navigate for Africans living, working, and doing business globally.

Blomgram needed to simplify and scale its cross-border payment experience while building trust and differentiating itself in a competitive fintech market.

Users struggled with unclear fees, exchange rates, transaction status, and the complexity of sending and managing money across different currencies.

Existing cross-border payment experiences were often fragmented, complex, and lacked the transparency users needed to feel confident about their transactions.

Needs: A centralized multi-currency wallet, easy currency exchange, and clear financial insights.

sections.body:
The design focused on four primary goals:

Make sending money understandable from the first interaction to confirmation.

Clearly communicate exchange rates, fees, recipient amounts, and transaction status.

03 Create a unified financial experience

Bring transfers, balances, currencies, and transaction history into one coherent product.

sections.heading: Signup & Authentication Experience
sections.body:
I designed Blomgram’s signup flow to make account creation simple, fast, and familiar. Users can sign up with Apple, Google, or their phone number, reducing the need for lengthy forms.

The goal was to minimize friction, build trust from the first interaction, and get users into the platform quickly while keeping the experience clean and intuitive.

sections.heading: User Onboarding & Verification
sections.body:
I structured the experience into clear, progressive steps—from country selection and email registration to OTP verification. The country selector was designed to scale as more markets are introduced, while reusable form components and consistent interaction patterns create a foundation for future onboarding requirements.
UX Focus
 Reduced cognitive load through a simple step-by-step flow.
 Clear hierarchy and familiar form interactions.
 Country selection designed for a growing international user base.
 OTP verification provides a focused, easy-to-complete authentication step.
 Clear feedback states distinguish between inactive and completed actions.
Business Impact  The design creates an onboarding foundation that can scale with geographic expansion and growing user base, while maintaining a consistent experience. The emphasis is on reducing onboarding friction, supporting user completion, and creating reusable patterns that make future product expansion more efficient.

sections.heading: Wallet flow and transactions

Designed a scalable fintech wallet and transaction experience, focused on making currency management, trading, and transfers simple and intuitive.
The design prioritizes clear navigation, easy currency selection, transparent transaction details, and reusable components, creating a consistent user experience while providing a flexible foundation for multiple currencies, markets, and future financial services.

sections.heading: Reflections
sections.body:
Deploying rapid, atomic component design libraries drastically expedited engineering cycles, ensuring visual alignment from concept straight to finished code in weeks.

Integrating our clean interface patterns with legacy financial databases required building advanced middleware strategies to balance low network speeds.

High-net-worth users prioritize speed and clarity over flashy features. Elegant simplicity will always defeat visual noise when dealing with massive portfolios.

Future iterations could provide deeper voice-controlled interface states and advanced custom predictive analytics for sophisticated users.
